verdict.rationale: Granola automatically produces AI-enhanced meeting summaries. Its default summarisation adapts to different formats, and templates can be chosen or customised per call type. Each note line traces back to its transcript source, notes can be shared by link, and a community user calls it highly capable at summarisation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries contain distinct decisions and next-steps/action-item sections, and independent evidence that output is share-ready without editing.
